snippet.title: Sanju, Dhir Removes All Fear | IND vs NZ | 1st T20I
snippet.description:
BHUVIIII IS BACK… AND NAMAN DHIR JUST SAVED THE DAY?! 😭🔥

India chased down 226 against New Zealand, but not before giving us a mini heart attack. Harshit and Rayhaan break down Glenn Phillips' ridiculous 82, Sanju Samson's beautiful start, Bhuvi's very forgettable comeback, and Naman Dhir turning into an absolute monster with 42 off 15. Plus, is this series Bhuvi's audition for a permanent spot, has Naman sealed his place, and WHERE DOES VAIBHAV SOORYAVANSHI FIT IN?! 👀🏏 And if that wasn't enough cricket chaos, we discuss Sri Lanka's insane 429-run chase and South Africa pulling off one of the wildest Test comebacks against Australia!

snippet.title: IYER ON FIRE GOES HIGHER, NOT A LIAR | IND vs WI | 1st T20
snippet.description:
IYER JUST SAID “MOVE ASIDE.” 😭🔥

Shreyas Iyer absolutely went nuclear with a 102 off 43 as India chased down 172 against West Indies, while India's spinners ran through the batting lineup and Naman Dhir picked up three wickets. Harshit and Rayhaan break down Iyer's ridiculous hundred, Sanju Samson's early dismissal, Hope and Rutherford's fightback, and what India might be cooking in this 5-match series. Plus, Harmanpreet to Smriti, Bhuvi's long-awaited India comeback, and why it's officially time to start the Justice for Shami campaign. 👀🏏

snippet.title: Records Abhishek Sharma Broke!😱🫡
snippet.description: This is basically a quick reaction/discussion video where Harshit and Rayhaan go through the insane records Abhishek Sharma broke during his 30-ball T20I century against Afghanistan. Instead of reviewing the whole match, they focus on just how absurd the innings was—breaking Rohit Sharma's long-standing Indian record, setting the fastest T20I century by a player from a Full Member nation, reaching a hundred in just 8.3 overs, and finishing with a strike rate that was miles ahead of anyone else in the game. The whole video is basically them reacting to the stats and realizing how ridiculous the knock actually was.

snippet.title: Abhishek has no SHARAM | IND vs AFG | T20I Series Review
snippet.description:
"Abhishek Sharma might actually be unemployed... because there's no way that's legal. 😭🔥"

Harshit and Rayhaan react to Abhishek Sharma's ridiculous 30-ball century against Afghanistan, Sanju Samson's confidence-boosting knock, and another dominant India whitewash. We talk about Abhishek breaking records for fun, NKR looking like a serious Hardik Pandya backup, Bumrah continuing to Bumrah, and why this ended up being one of the most entertaining bilateral series in a long time despite being completely one-sided. Plus, are bilateral series losing relevance, and what can cricket learn from football and the Premier League? 👀🏏
